a: Use nouns for resources (/users/123), not verbs (/getUser).
Return structured errors: {code, message, details} with proper status codes.
HATEOAS includes links in responses so clients discover next actions.
Bulk endpoints reduce round-trips for multi-item create/update/delete.
Expose X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset so clients can back off.
ETag/If-None-Match enable conditional requests and 304 Not Modified.
Use version fields or ETags so concurrent updates do not silently overwrite.
Cursor pagination uses opaque cursors instead of OFFSET for stable large lists.
Idempotency-Key header makes safe retries of POST requests.
